provenance.thread_mapping: Robob #1006 reporter link and reporter activity title confirmed

commands.cmd:
cat > tmp/card35/run-final-gate.sh <<'SH'
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
expected_head=$1
[[ ${OFFBOX_RUN_ID-} =~ ^run-[0-9a-z-]+$ ]]
# The parent supplies the box selected by offbox for this unique run.
assignment="/tmp/torssh35-${OFFBOX_RUN_ID}.box"
for ((n=0;n<60;n++)); do
    [[ ! -s "$assignment" ]] || break
    sleep 1
done
[[ -s "$assignment" ]] || { echo 'Missing allocation assignment' >&2; exit 1; }
read -r allocated_box < "$assignment"
[[ $allocated_box =~ ^bx_[a-z0-9]+$ ]]
rm "$assignment"
exec bash scripts/check-formal-reuse.sh --head "$expected_head" \
    --coverage docs/evidence/reconnect-core/formal-coverage.json --box-id "$allocated_box"
SH
bash -n tmp/card35/run-final-gate.sh
